cohorts.do_not_reuse_transfer_eligible_ids: Its10 IDs require only NUDT5 observations; 2,3,4,5 lack NUDT14 and are not paired.
cohorts.source: All23 graphs, all46 target cells, including overlaps and untested

endpoint_contract.numeric: finite positive reported_mean, finite nonnegative reported_sd; comparator =; no bound
endpoint_contract.right_censored: no numeric mean/SD; comparator >; bound 50 uM; strict true
endpoint_contract.unknown_values: null in JSON; empty CSV field, never 0/NaN/inf/string NA sentinel. Table1 raw NA is explicitly decoded as >50, not generic missing.
endpoint_contract.untested: no comparator/mean/SD/bound/biological_n; not an inactive or a bound

estimand.orientation: R>1 or L>0 favors lower NUDT5 reported mean under these assay conditions

identity.candidates: candidate matches retained separately; 11=NC5-02=ACT-19 is one graph
identity.diagnostic_exclusion: ANY exact canonical, neutral parent, or parent-tautomer training match excludes compound from model diagnostic, never from source pharmacology
identity.parent: FragmentParent then Uncharger, canonical isomeric SMILES; exclusion flag only
identity.tautomer: TautomerEnumerator.Canonicalize(neutral parent), canonical isomeric SMILES; exclusion flag only; may erase details
identity.training: 45 valid unique original repository graphs; invalid ACT-18 quarantined, not repaired
identity.uniqueness: All23 original compound IDs and canonical graphs must be unique; aliases/conflicting graphs fail closed, not silently deduplicated

atomicity_tests: write/validation failure leaves no partial published report; staging cleaned
io.csv: UTF-8, newline="", LF records, csv.DictReader/Writer; exact expected header, no duplicate/empty headers, no ragged rows, strict=True, no duplicate IDs; preserve quoted commas and original raw text whitespace
io.json: allow_nan=False, finite values only, nulls preserved, explicit schema_version; reject duplicate object keys when reading.
io.manifest: Record input/content hashes, actual command/revision/dirty state, dependency versions and retrieval timestamps; never rewrite historical provenance to new revision.
io.output: New or empty directory only. Validate all inputs before publishing artifacts; do not overwrite nonempty dirs or individual files. Stage in destination filesystem, flush+fsync and os.link publish as existing pipeline.write_json; clean owned staging on failure.

ownership: Only research/selectivity/; original CSVs and historical numerical JSON immutable

presentation.allowed: Per-compound means/SD/bounds, R or strict bound/log same orientation, scores and descriptive counts/ranks only
presentation.high_score_definition: No threshold/class. Display score and within-six descriptive rank, not a tuned favorable cutoff.
presentation.optional_future_figure: If implemented: log10 R x-axis (dimensionless; >0 favors NUDT5); fixed score y-axis (uncalibrated); label compound IDs; arrows/open bound markers for13, separate not-estimable strip for12/15, separate overlap/untested table; include n=6, only3 point ratios; colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito and shapes; no fabricated uncertainty bands; export PNG/PDF/SVG atomically with downloadable artifacts.
presentation.ordering: Source-author order; model table historical Equal_mean descending, disclose all6 methods and tied ranks
presentation.precision: Full binary64 values in JSON/CSV; rounding only presentation. Raw source strings preserve reported precision.
presentation.primary_output: All23-row source table plus clearly separated six-row model diagnostic table
presentation.rank_rule: 1 + number of eligible scores strictly greater, independently per scenario/method; ties share min rank, subsequent ranks skip. Noneligible rank is null. No R rank for censored/missing rows.

ratio_rules.interpretation: Any R>0 and any real log10 R; no informative finite bound or direction

score_join.Equal_mean_definition: Existing arithmetic mean of RF,GBT,SVM_RBF,Nearest_active only; not all six methods
score_join.keys: source_compound ID plus exact original source_smiles, canonical graph and all recomputed identity keys; compare raw ledger/source strings and input hashes too
score_join.missing_score: Retain compound and mark unavailable with reason; fail score table release if a promised join is missing/ambiguous, do not fill with zero or refit
score_join.scenario_separation: Show historical and already-recorded authenticated-reference sensitivity separately. Never choose better scores or pool scenarios; no new model run.

semantic_acceptance_checks: exact23 source rows and46 endpoint cells; each compound has exactly one NUDT5 and NUDT14
all16 table1 cells exactly verified with NA->>50; outside rows not falsely table-verified
source/long projections and score columns consistent; exact source and input hashes checked
5 point +1 upper +2 double +15 missing; nonoverlap3+1+2, six paired and four informative
ratio comparator/point/bound/null/log consistency; >50 is strict; no finite bound for double-censored
recompute original45 identities and reference replacements; overlap10/11 all levels, sensitivity adds6 only; candidate11=NC5-02
both score scenarios have23 rows and six frozen methods; joined values byte-numeric equal to source JSON; method ties retained
all uncertainty/control/SD discrepancies retained; no source overwrite or synthetic biological rows
status: Local retrospective analysis contract; not preregistered, not a new experiment; source outcomes/scores already inspected
uncertainty: Retain source SDs and definitions at target level only. No ratio SD, propagated CI, significance, covariance assumption, raw replicate synthesis or biological bootstrap.
